SINK: The create_api_key endpoint (line 637, POST /api/admin/api-keys) creates API keys with is_active=True (model default, models.py APIKey class) and returns the raw key once. However, NO corresponding endpoint exists to list keys, toggle is_active to False, or delete/revoke a compromised key. The integration_create_ticket endpoint (line 655) checks APIKey.is_active.is_(True), but without a revocation API the flag is permanently true. A leaked API key grants indefinite access with no operational way to cut it off short of direct database manipulation. This violates the session/token lifecycle requirement under CWE‑613.
